The liquid flame is created through a unique chemical {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} caused by the mixture of methane, hydrogen sulfide, and a mysterious substance deep within the guts of the Fire Breather. The beasts are often deployed for clearing out entrenched enemy positions.

entries.name: Yorik-Kul
entries: Yorik-Kul, or surge-coral in {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} Standard, is an organic device used by the Yuuzhan Vong and implanted into slaves, which then allow the slave to receive mental commands from a yammosk or a dhuryam. This, however, comes at a cost, since the wearers will eventually lose their sentience and become mindless beings. Slaves that have lost their minds are used as cannon fodder to absorb {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} fire on the battlefield. Surge-coral also causes its wearers to grow thin and vanish in the Force. Eventually, the Shapers developed surge-coral that is less detrimental to the slaves, which only causes pain instead of turning them into drones.

entries.name: Yammosk
entries: Yammosks, or war coordinators, are creatures used as coordinators during battles to send orders to other spacecraft, such as coralskippers, to optimize their actions. Sometimes, Yammosks are placed on covert operation missions where the creature uses its talents to link the mind of Yuuzhan Vong commandos. This provides such operatives with a secured means of communications as their thoughts are linked to one another. Yammosks are at least partially sentient. If destroyed or badly injured, a Yuuzhan Vong war force typically descended into chaos without the guiding influence of its yammosk. A yammosk's control over its forces was also capable of being disrupted through the use of gravitic amplitude modulators.
Physically, yammosks resemble huge brains, kept in vats, which trail thousands of tentacles. Its only solid bodily structure is its single tooth which is hidden within its boneless flesh.
The tooth is capable of biting with incredible force allowing it to break through rock and ice which are {@condition Weakened|sw5e-phb|weakened} through the secretion of acids.
Yammosk are spawned rather then being created. Immature members of this species are required to be partially submerged in nutrient liquid but in time they become full air-breathers.
A yammosk is considered the physical form of the Yuuzhan Vong god Yun-Yammka, the Slayer body manifested onto the mortal plane.

data.name: Zakkeg
entries: Zakkegs are rare alpha-predators indigenous to Dxun. Huge, armored quadrupeds, they are solitary and territorial. Even Mandalorians are impressed by someone who kills a Zakkeg, and one could gain great honor for proving one's success. They prey upon most creatures which they can catch, including cannoks, maalraas and even bomas.

{@b {@i Popular Culture.}} Zakkegs are known for being crafty and stubborn. The mercenary Saponza compared the Tusken Raider known as the Jundland General to a zakkeg after discovering that he had several heavily fortified bases. Associates of the smuggler Liana Kor described her as being as "stubborn as a zakkeg, and twice as mean."
{@i "Its a huge, red lizard that's built like a Baragwin battle tank. It has a hide so thick it might as well be durasteel plating."}
―Mandalorian guard captain

monster.name: The Ashla
immune: poison; kinetic and energy damage from unenhanced attacks

trait.name: Innate Forcecasting
entries: The Ashla's forceasting ability is Wisdom (force save DC 23). It can innately cast the following {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}:

trait.name: Forcecasting
entries: At will: *{@spell Force Push/Pull|sw5e-phb|force push/pull}, {@spell Force Sight|sw5e-phb|force sight}, {@spell Force Throw|sw5e-phb|force throw}, {@spell Project|sw5e-phb|project}, {@spell Sense Force|sw5e-phb|sense force}, {@spell Sever Force|sw5e-phb|sever force}*

trait.name: Forcecasting
entries: 1/day each: *{@spell Improved Force Camouflage|sw5e-phb|improved force camouflage}, {@spell Master Revitalize|sw5e-phb|master revitalize}, {@spell Stasis Field|sw5e-phb|stasis field}, {@spell Wall of Light|sw5e-phb|wall of light}*

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/day)
entries: If the Ashla fails a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Limited Force Immunity
entries: The Ashla is immune to powers of 5th level or lower unless it wishes to be affected. It has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against all other powers and force effects.

trait.name: Radiance
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, the Ashla can emit a blinding light. A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the Ashla must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failure, the creature is {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded} and {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} until the start of its next turn. The {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} is made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} if a creature is of a dark alignment. A creature that successfully saves against this effect is immune to this ability for 24 hours.

trait.name: Radiant Attacks
entries: The Ashla's attacks are considered enhanced.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Ashla makes three {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}, or it uses its light of the force and makes an unarmed strike.

action.name: Unarmed Strikes
entries: *{@atk mw} * {@hit 14} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 ({@dice 3d8+6}) kinetic damage plus 13 ({@dice 3d8}) force damage.

action.name: Light of the Force
entries: The Ashla directs a beam of pure force at a creature it can see within 120 feet. The target must make a DC 23 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking 55 (10d10) force damage on a failed save or half damage on a successful save.

action.name: Grace of the Ashla
entries: The Ashla targets a creature within 60 feet and fills it with the power of the light side. The target creature regains 40 (6d10+7) hitpoints and is cured of all poisons and diseases affecting it, and if it is {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened}, {@condition Paralyzed|sw5e-phb|paralyzed}, {@condition Petrified|sw5e-phb|petrified}, or {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned}, those conditions are ended.

action.name: Peace
entries: The Ashla attempts to quell the aggressive and hateful emotions and thoughts in creatures within a 60 foot radius. Each creature of the Ashla's choosing must make a DC 23 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failure, a creature cannot take aggressive actions until the start of its next turn. If the Ashla or a creature unaffected by this ability harms an affected target, the effect ends immediately.

reaction.name: Shield of the Light
entries: The Ashla adds 8 to its AC against a melee attack that would hit it. If the attack misses because of this {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}, the attacker takes 22 (4d10) force damage.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: The Ashla teleports to a point it can see within 60 feet.

legendary.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: The Ashla makes an unarmed strike.

legendary.name: Innate Forcepower (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Ashla casts an innate {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

legendary.name: Peace (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The Ashla uses its Peace action.

legendaryHeader: The The Ashla can take 4 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The The Ashla regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

monster.name: The Bendu
immune: ion, and energy damage from unenhanced weapons

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the Bendu moves at least 10 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a horn attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 17 (4d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 22 Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or be pushed up to 10 ft. away and knocked {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}.

trait.name: Enhanced Attacks
entries: The Bendu’s attacks are considered enhanced.

trait.name: Innate Forcecasting
entries: The Bendu’s forceasting ability is Wisdom (force save DC 22). It can innately cast the following {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}:

trait.name: Forcecasting
entries: At will: *{@spell Force Push/Pull|sw5e-phb|force push/pull}, {@spell Force Sight|sw5e-phb|force sight}, {@spell Force Throw|sw5e-phb|force throw}, {@spell Sense Emotion|sw5e-phb|sense emotion}, {@spell Sense Force|sw5e-phb|sense force}, {@spell Sever Force|sw5e-phb|sever force}*

trait.name: Forcecasting
entries: 1/day each: *{@spell Earthquake|sw5e-phb|earthquake}, {@spell Force Storm|sw5e-phb|force storm}, {@spell Improved Force Camouflage|sw5e-phb|improved force camouflage}, {@spell Mass Animation|sw5e-phb|mass animation}, {@spell Precognition|sw5e-phb|precognition}*

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/day)
entries: If the Bendu fails a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Limited Force Immunity
entries: The Bendu is immune to {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 5th level or lower unless it wishes to be affected. It has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against all other {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} and force effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Bendu makes two claw attacks and one horn attack, or it casts one {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} and makes a claw attack.

action.name: Claws
entries: *{@atk mw} * {@hit 14} to hit, Reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit* 22 ({@dice 4d8+6}) kinetic damage.

action.name: Horns
entries: *{@atk mw} * {@hit 14} to hit, Reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit* 28 ({@dice 4d10+6}) kinetic damage.

action.name: Teleport
entries: The Bendu teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

action.name: Lightning Strike
entries: The Bendu calls a bolt of lightning out of the sky, or from the air if underground or indoors, to strike a point it can see within 60 feet. All creatures within 20 feet of the target point must make a DC 22 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking 27 (6d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The bendu makes a claw attack.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: The Bendu uses its teleport action.

legendary.name: Innate Power
entries: The Bendu casts an at will {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

legendaryHeader: The The Bendu can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The The Bendu regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

monster.name: The Bogan
immune: poison; kinetic and energy damage from unenhanced attacks

trait.name: Born of the Dark side
entries: The Bogan can take the {@action Hide|sw5e-phb} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on each turn while it is in dim light or {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, even if it is being observed.

trait.name: Enhanced Attacks
entries: The Bogan's attacks are enhanced.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The Bogan does not provoke attacks of opportunity while flying.

trait.name: Innate Forcecasting
entries: The Bogan's innate {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} is Charisma (save DC 23). It can innately cast the following powers: At will: {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, *{@spell Enfeeble|sw5e-phb|enfeeble}, {@spell Feedback|sw5e-phb|feedback}, {@spell Force Push/Pull|sw5e-phb|force push/pull}, {@spell Force Throw|sw5e-phb|force throw}, {@spell Sever Force|sw5e-phb|sever force}, wound* 3/day each: *crush, fear, {@spell Force Lightning|sw5e-phb|force lightning}, {@spell Force Suppression|sw5e-phb|force suppression}, {@spell Improved Force Scream|sw5e-phb|improved force scream}* 1/day each: *{@spell Death Field|sw5e-phb|death field}, {@spell Improved Force Camouflage|sw5e-phb|improved force camouflage}, rage, ruin*

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/day)
entries: If the Bogan fails a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Limited Force Immunity
entries: The Bogan immune to powers of 5th level or lower unless it wishes to be affected. It has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against all other powers and force effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Bogan makes one bite attack, one wing attack, one claws attack and one blade of the darksider attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: *{@atk mw} * {@hit 14} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 28 ({@dice 4d10+6}) kinetic damage.

action.name: Claws
entries: *{@atk mw} * {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 16 ({@dice 3d6+6}) slashing damage and the target is {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} and {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb|restrained} (escape {@dc 22}). The Bogan can grapple one creature at a time if it is on the ground or two if it is flying. Claws grappling a creature can’t attack any other creature.

action.name: Wing
entries: *{@atk mw} * {@hit 14} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 24 ({@dice 4d8+6}) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or be knocked {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}.

action.name: Blade of the Darksider
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 ({@dice 2d8+6}) kinetic damage, or 17 ({@dice 2d10+6}) kinetic damage if used with two hands, plus 27 ({@dice 6d8}) force damage.

legendary.name: Hide
entries: The Bogan takes the {@action Hide|sw5e-phb} action.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: The Bogan teleports to a location it can see within 100 feet of it.

legendary.name: Shroud (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Bogan radiates {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} in a 30-foot radius. The {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness} lasts until the start of the Bogan's next turn.

legendary.name: Innate Power (Costs 2 Actions.)
entries: The Bogan casts an innate power.

legendaryHeader: The The Bogan can take 4 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The The Bogan regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

trait.name: Assassinate
entries: During its first turn, the assassin droid has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit the assassin droid scores against a surprised creature is a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit}.

trait.name: Circuitry
entries: The droid has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against effects that would deal ion or lightning damage.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: The probe droid has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: The assassin droid deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when it hits a target with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} and has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the assassin that isn't {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} and the assassin doesn't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the roll.

trait.name: Swarm Transport
entries: The assassin droid can transport a maximum of 1 Probe Killer Swarm, which it can deploy using its Deploy Probe Killers action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sssassin droid makes two leg slash attacks.

action.name: Leg Slash
entries: *{@atk mw} * {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8+3}) kinetic damage.

action.name: Deploy Probe Killers
entries: This droid swarm appears in any space within 5 ft. of the assassin droid.

reaction.name: Second Chance
entries: When the droid reaches zero {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, it may immediately take the deploy probe killers action.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a tiny droid. The swarm can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} or gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}.

trait.name: Circuitry
entries: The swarm has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against effects that would deal ion or lightning damage.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (4/Turn)
entries: The swarm deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage when it hits a target with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} and has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the swarm that isn't {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} and the swarm doesn't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the roll.

action.name: Multiattack (swarm has more than half HP)
entries: The swarm makes 4 leg slash attacks.

action.name: Multiattack (swarm has less than or equal to half HP)
entries: The swarm makes 2 leg slash attacks.

action.name: Leg Slash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4+4}) kinetic damage.

trait.name: Battle Droid Swarm
entries: When an ally of the battle droid hits a hostile creature that it can see with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, the battle droid can use its {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}, against that creature.

trait.name: Circuitry
entries: The droid has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against effects that would deal ion or lightning damage.

action.name: Blaster Rifle
entries: *{@atk rw} * {@hit 4} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 ({@dice 1d8+2}) energy damage.

action.name: Stock Strike
entries: *{@atk mw} * {@hit 1} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 1 ({@dice 1d4}-1) kinetic damage.

trait.name: Battle Droid Swarm
entries: When an ally of the battle droid hits a hostile creature that it can see with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, the battle droid can use its {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}, against that creature.

trait.name: Circuitry
entries: The droid has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against effects that would deal ion or lightning damage.

trait.name: Reactive
entries: The squad can take one {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} each turn.

trait.name: Squad
entries: The squad can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and can move through openings large enough for a Medium droid. The squad is immune to any power or effect that would alter its form.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The squad makes four {@item Blaster rifle|sw5e-phb} attacks, or two {@item Blaster rifle|sw5e-phb} attacks if it has half its {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} or fewer.

action.name: Blaster Rifle
entries: *{@atk rw} * {@hit 4} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 ({@dice 1d8+2}) energy damage.

action.name: Massed Fire
entries: The squad fires *en masse* at a point within 150 ft. Each creature of the squad's choice in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 13 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, a creature takes 36 (8d8) energy damage, or 18 (4d8) energy damage if the squad has half its {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} or fewer. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.

trait.name: Beast A.I
entries: The basilisk counts as an animal for the sake of Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling|sw5e-phb}) checks made on it or while riding it.

trait.name: Circuitry
entries: The basilisk has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against effects that would deal ion or lightning damage.

trait.name: Mourning
entries: If a rider using the basilisk as a mount is killed, the basilisk will {@spell Release|sw5e-phb|release} a pained howl and attempt to kill the one responsible without regard for its own safety.

trait.name: Weapons Compartment
entries: A rider using the basilisk as a mount can securely store up to 20 lbs. of weapons and 1 day's worth of rations in a storage hatch within reach of their seat.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The basilisk makes three weapon attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: *{@atk mw} * {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 ({@dice 2d6+4}) kinetic damage.

action.name: Light Laser Cannon
entries: *{@atk rw} * {@hit 6} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 ({@dice 2d8+3}) energy damage.

action.name: Pulse-Wave Cannon
entries: *{@atk rw} * {@hit 6} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. *Hit:* 10 ({@dice 2d6+3}) fire damage.

action.name: Shatter-Missile Launcher (4/Day)
entries: The basilisk launches a missile at a point within 300 feet that it can see. Each creature within a 15-foot sphere of that point must make a DC 16 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking 18 (4d8) kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Shockwave Generator (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The basilisk unleashes a crude sonic blast from the rods comprising its nose. Each creature in a 20-foot radius must make a DC 15 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking 18 (4d8) sonic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Additionally, on a failed save, the creature is knocked {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone} if it is Large or smaller. The basilisk cannot use this attack while it is in flight.

trait.name: Circuitry
entries: The droid has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against effects that would deal ion or lightning damage.

trait.name: Ball Form
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, the destroyer droid can transform into or out of ball form. While in ball form, the destroyer droid has increased {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, but it can not attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The destroyer droid makes two weapon attacks.

action.name: Claws
entries: *{@atk mw} * {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 ({@dice 2d6+4}) kinetic damage and the target is {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled}.

action.name: Rend
entries: The destroyer droid tears apart a {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} opponent. A {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} creature must make a DC 15 Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failure, the creature takes 18 (4d6+4) kinetic damage and is {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} until the end of the destroyer droids' next turn. On a success, the creature takes normal weapon damage.

reaction.name: Deflector Shield
entries: The destroyer droid adds 2 to its AC against one attack that would hit it. To do so, the destroyer droid must see the attacker.

trait.name: Defiant (1/day)
entries: The ambush master can add a {@dice d4} to a skill check or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.

trait.name: Swift Responder
entries: The ambush master ignores {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain} and gains a +4 bonus to {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} rolls in addition to its Dexterity modifier. Additionally, on its first turn in combat, the ambush master has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against creatures that have not acted yet.

trait.name: Ranger's Quarry (3/day)
entries: Once per round, the ambush master can mark a creature within 90 ft. as its quarry (no action required). Once per round, when the ambush master hits its quarry with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, it deals and addtional 1d8 weapon damage to it. Additionally, the ambush master has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) or Wisdom ({@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}) checks to track the creature while the quarry on the same planet as it.

trait.name: Accomplished Ambusher
entries: When the ambush master takes the attack action against a creature that is surprised, it can make an additional attack against that creature as part of that action.

trait.name: Mark of the Stalker
entries: When the ambush master is hidden from the target of its Ranger's Quarry feature, the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} the ambush master makes each round against that creature does not automatically reveal its position. Instead, the ambush master must make a Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the quarry's Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check. On a success, the ambush master remains hidden. If the ambush master is more than 30 ft. away from its quarry, the Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}) check is made with {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

trait.name: Concealment
entries: While in {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}, the ambush master is {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible} to any creature that relies on {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision} to see it.

trait.name: Hidden Crippler (3/day)
entries: When the ambush master hits a creature with a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} while hidden, it can force the creature to make a DC 15 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the creature’s {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is reduced to 0 until the end of the ambush master's next turn.

trait.name: Techcasting
entries: The ambush master is a 9th-level techcaster. Its {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} is Intelligence (power save DC 15, +7 to hit with tech attacks, 18 tech points).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ambush master makes two weapon attacks.

action.name: Sniper Rifle
entries: *{@atk rw} * {@hit 11} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 ({@dice 1d12+5}) energy damage.

action.name: Techblade
entries: *{@atk mw} * {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 ({@dice 1d6+5}) kinetic damage.

trait.name: Light Shield
entries: While wielding the heavy {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} or the {@item Techblade|sw5e-phb} the Bounty Hunters AC increases by 1

trait.name: Enhanced Tech
entries: When you deal damage to a creature with your weapon, you can increase the damage by 1d6. The damage is of the same type as the weapon’s damage. (Damage is included in the attack section)

trait.name: Distengration
entries: When a creature is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} by the disruptor rifle, it must make a DC 12 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, it dies immediately without making {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|death saving throws}. A disintegrated creature and everything it is wearing and carrying are reduced to a pile of fine gray dust. A creature destroyed in this way can not be revitalized.

trait.name: Tech Casting
entries: The Bounty Hunter is a 6th level techcaster it's tech casting ability is Intelligence (tech save DC 16, +7 to hit with power attacks, 24 tech points). The Bounty Hunter knows the following powers:

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Bounty Hunter makes two melee weapon attacks or two ranged weapon attacks.

action.name: Heavy Blaster Pistol
entries: *Ranged Weapon Attack*. +7 to hit, range 40/160, one target. *Hit* 11 (1d8+1d6 +4) energy damage.

action.name: Disruptor Rifle
entries: *Ranged Weapon Attack*. +7 to hit, range 100/400, one target. *Hit* 12 (1d10+1d6 +4) energy damage.

action.name: Techblade
entries: *Melee Weapon Attack*: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit*: 10 (1d6+ 1d6 +4) kinetic damage.

action.name: Carbonite Blast (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The Bounty Hunter produces a beam of {@spell Carbonite|sw5e-phb|carbonite} energy from his {@item Wrist launcher|sw5e-phb|wrist launcher} in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking 30 (10d6) Cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. On a fail the creature will have its {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} halved until the end of your next turn. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, that creature is frozen in {@spell Carbonite|sw5e-phb|carbonite} for 1 hour.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the Gunslinger is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to take only half damage, the Gunslinger instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Nimble
entries: The Gunslinger can take the Dash or Hide actions as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on its turn.

trait.name: Sharpshooter
entries: The Gunslinger adds 2 to its {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} with {@filter blasters|items|firearm=true}.

trait.name: Sharpshooting Mastery
entries: The Gunslinger ignores half and three-quarters {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}, and does not suffer {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} at long range. Additionally, the gunslinger can take a -5 penalty on an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} with a {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true}. If the attack hits, the gunslinger adds +10 to the damage roll.

trait.name: Techcasting
entries: The Gunslinger is a 20th-level techcaster. Its {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} is Intelligence (power save DC 16, +8 to hit with power attacks). The Gunslinger has 23 tech points and knows the following {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}:

trait.name: Tech Resistance
entries: The Gunslinger has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Gunslinger makes three attacks, or it casts a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} and makes an attack.

action.name: Vibroblade
entries: *{@atk mw} * {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 ({@dice 1d8+3}) kinetic damage.

action.name: Heavy Blasters
entries: *{@atk rw} * {@hit 12} to hit, ranged 40/160 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 ({@dice 3d8+5}) energy damage.

action.name: 1...2...3! (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The Gunslinger unleashes a barrage of gunfire in a 60-foot cone. The Gunslinger can make a {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} attack against each creature in that area, dealing an extra 14 (4d6) piercing damage on a hit. A creature hit by an attack in this way must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or be {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} until the end of the Gunslinger’s next turn.

action.name: Thermal Detonators (3/day)
entries: The Gunslinger throws a grenade, choosing a point within 45ft. Each creature within 10 feet must make a DC 13 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes 7 (2d6) fire damage and 7 (2d6) kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one. A creature that fails the save is knocked {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}.

monster.name: Legendary Duros Hunter

trait.name: Breathing Mask
entries: The Duros has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison}.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/day)
entries: If the Duros fails a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Strong-Willed
entries: The Duros has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} to resist being {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb} or {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb}.

trait.name: Techcasting
entries: The Duros is a 16th-level techcaster. Its {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} is Intelligence (power save DC 18, +10 to hit with power attacks). The Duros has 36 tech points and knows the following {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}:

trait.name: Tech Resistance
entries: The Duros has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} and effects.

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While wearing no armor and wielding no {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}, the Duros's adds its Intelligence modifier to its AC (included).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Duros makes four ranged attacks or three melee attacks, or it casts a power and makes an attack.

action.name: Heavy Blaster Pistol
entries: *Ranged Weapon Attack* +11 to hit, range 40/160 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (3d8+5) energy damage.

action.name: Techblade
entries: *{@atk mw} * {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit: 18* ({@dice 3d8+5}) kinetic damage.

action.name: Thermal Detonators (5/day)
entries: The Duros throws a grenade, choosing a point within 40ft. Each creature within 10 feet must make a DC 13 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes 7 (2d6) fire damage and 7 (2d6) kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one. A creature that fails the save is knocked {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The Duros makes an attack.

legendary.name: Eliminate (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Duros picks a target within 40 feet and makes a Heavy {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} attack at {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}. If the attack hits, the target takes damage as normal, and must make a DC 18 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failure, the target is {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} until the end of the Duros's next turn.

legendary.name: Tech (Costs 1-3 Actions)
entries: The Duros casts a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, spending 1 legendary action per level of power cast.

legendaryHeader: The Legendary Duros Hunter can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Legendary Duros Hunter regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

monster.name: Legendary Enhanced Hunter

trait.name: Cunning Action
entries: On each of his turns, the Hunter can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to Dash or Disengage.

trait.name: Keen Senses
entries: The Hunter has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) Checks.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If The Hunter fails a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Precision Shot (4/day)
entries: The Hunter can roll his next ranged attack with {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

trait.name: Sharpshooting Mastery
entries: The Hunter's ranged attacks ignore half-{@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} and three-quarters {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}. He does not get {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on his ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack rolls} while attacking at long range.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Hunter makes three {@item Blaster rifle|sw5e-phb} attacks or three melee weapon attacks.

action.name: Heavy Blaster Rifle
entries: *Ranged Weapon Attack.* +11 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (2d10+6) energy damage.

action.name: Rifle Bash
entries: *Melee Weapon Attack.* +10 to hit, one target. *Hit:* 12 (2d6+5) kinetic damage, and the target must make a DC 18 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or become dazed.

action.name: Fire Blade
entries: *Melee Weapon Attack.* +11 to hit, one target. *Hit:* 9 (1d6+6) kinetic damage and 10 (3d6) fire damage.

action.name: Mini Grenades (1/day)
entries: The Hunter flings a barrage of mini grenades at a point within 55 feet. Each creature within 15 ft. must make a DC 19 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes 35 (10d6) kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one.

action.name: Smoke Grenade (1/day)
entries: The hunter throws a smoke grenade at a point within 55 feet. The smoke grenade spews a thick cloud of fog in a 15ft radius, lasting 10 rounds. When entering the fog or starting its turn there, a creature must make a DC 19 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (4d8) {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage and is {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned}, or half as much on a successful save and is not {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned}.

reaction.name: Retaliatory Strike
entries: If a melee attack misses the Hunter, he can use his {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make a rifle bash attack against that creature.

legendary.name: Heavy Fire
entries: The Hunter makes one heavy {@item Blaster rifle|sw5e-phb} attack.

legendary.name: Grenades (Costs 2 actions)
entries: The Hunter can use either of his grenade attacks.

legendary.name: Duck and Weave
entries: The Hunter moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}.

legendaryHeader: The Legendary Enhanced Hunter can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Legendary Enhanced Hunter regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

monster.name: Legendary Gand Findsman

trait.name: Alert
entries: The Gand can not be surprised while conscious and has a +5 to his {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} rolls. Other creatures are not able to gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against him as a result of being hidden from the Hunter.

trait.name: Close Quarters Shooting
entries: The Gand's ranged attacks do not have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} within 5ft.

trait.name: Findsman
entries: The Gand has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} & Survial) checks made to locate his prey.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: When the Gand fails a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Lungless
entries: The Gand does not have to breathe and is immune to any affects that rely on breathing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Gand makes three weapon attacks.

action.name: W-90 Concussion Rifle
entries: *Ranged Weapon Attack.* +11 to hit, range 40/160, one target. *Hit:* 19 (3d8+6) energy damage and the target must succeed on a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC16) or be knocked {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}.

action.name: GRS-1 Snare Rifle (Recharge 5-6)
entries: *Ranged Weapon Attack.* +11 to hit, range 150/300, one target. *Hit:* The target is {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb|restrained} and must succeed at a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC 16) or be {@condition Paralyzed|sw5e-phb|paralyzed} until the end of it's next turn. The creature can use an action to attempt to escape the snare by succeeding on a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC 17) made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

action.name: Vibroblade
entries: *{@atk mw} * {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5ft., one target. *Hit:* 13 ({@dice 2d8+4}).

action.name: C-10 Stun Grenade (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The Gand throws a Stun grenade, choosing a point within 50 ft., exploding in a 15 ft. sphere. Each creature within 15 ft. must make a DC 16 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes 21 (6d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one. Additionally, on a failed save, the creature is {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} until the end of its next turn.

reaction.name: Precognition
entries: When a creature that the Gand can see attacks him. He can use his {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}.

reaction.name: Regenerative
entries: When the Gand takes damage, it can use its {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to regain 17 (3d10+2) {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} as long as the triggering damage would not have reduced the Gand to 0 hp.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The Gand makes a W-90 Concussion Rifle attack.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The Gand can move up to its {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}.

legendary.name: Preparation
entries: The Gand can recharge one or both of its recharge attacks.

legendaryHeader: The Legendary Gand Findsman can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Legendary Gand Findsman regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

monster.name: Legendary Mandalorian Bounty Hunter
resist: kinetic and energy damage from unenhanced weapons

trait.name: Aggressive
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, the Mandalorian can move up to its {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} toward a hostile creature that it can see.

trait.name: Close Quarters Shooter
entries: When the Mandalorian attacks, it can choose to make ranged weapon attacks without its {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, it can then use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to make an additional ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, also without its {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.

trait.name: Enhanced Tech
entries: The Mandalorian deals one extra die of damage with its weapons and equipment and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} with explosives have an additional +2 to the DC (included in the attack).

trait.name: Jetpack (10 minutes/day)
entries: Activating or deactivating the {@item Jetpack|sw5e-phb|jetpack} requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and, while active, the Mandalorian has a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 40 feet.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: The Mandalorian has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

trait.name: Moderately Armored
entries: While wearing {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}, the captain adds +1 to its AC (included).

trait.name: Ranger's Quarry
entries: The Mandalorian chooses a creature that it can see within 90 feet and marks it as their quarry. For the next 10 minutes, once per round it deals 4 (1d8) additional damage to its quarry. Additionally, the Mandalorian has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on any Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) or Wisdom ({@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}) check made to find its quarry while it’s on the same planet.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If The Mandalorian fails a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Mandalorian makes three {@item Carbine rifle|sw5e-phb|carbine rifle} attacks and uses either its {@item Thermal detonator|sw5e-phb|thermal detonator}, wrist flamer, or wrist missile, if available.

action.name: Carbine Rifle
entries: *{@atk rw} * Rapid 3, range 80/320 ft., one target within range must succeed on a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} ({@dc 21}) or take 20 ({@dice 3d8+7}) energy damage.

action.name: Jetpack Rocket (1/Day)
entries: *{@atk rw} * {@hit 13} to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 ({@dice 3d6+7}) kinetic damage, and each creature within 10 feet must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking 10 ({@dice 3d6}) kinetic damage on a failed save, or half on a successful save.

action.name: Thermal detonator (4/Day)
entries: The Mandalorian throws a grenade at a point within 40 ft. Each creature within 10 feet must make a DC 15 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes 10 (3d6) fire and 10 (3d6) kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one.

action.name: Wrist Flamer (3/Day)
entries: Each creature in a 15-foot cone or a 30-foot line must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC 15). A creature takes 14 (4d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Any flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried are {@condition Ignited|sw5e-phb|ignited}.

action.name: Wrist Missile (3/Day)
entries: *{@atk rw} * {@hit 12} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6+7}) kinetic damage, and each creature within 5 feet must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking 7 ({@dice 2d6}) kinetic damage on a failed save, or half on a successful save.

reaction.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries: . The Mandalorian halves the damage that it takes from an attack that hits it.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The Mandalorian can move up to his {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}.

legendary.name: Carbine Rifle
entries: The Mandalorian makes one {@item Carbine rifle|sw5e-phb|carbine rifle} attack.

legendary.name: Wire Restraint
entries: *{@atk rw} * {@hit 12} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. *Hit* The target is {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled}. On the target's turn, it can use an action to make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} ({@dc 15}) to attempt to break the wire.

legendaryHeader: The Legendary Mandalorian Bounty Hunter can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Legendary Mandalorian Bounty Hunter regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

monster.name: The Father, Avatar of Balance
immune: ion, and energy damage from unenhanced weapons
resist: and energy damage from enhanced weapons

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While in his humanoid form, the Father adds his Charisma modifier to his AC.

trait.name: Innate Forcecasting
entries: The father's {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} is Wisdom, (power save DC 23, +15 to hit with force attacks). It can innately cast the following {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}:

trait.name: Force Resistance
entries: The Father has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against universal {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, If the Son and Daughter are within 60ft of him, the Father also has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against Dark/Light side powers respectively.

trait.name: Enhanced Casting
entries: The Father's {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} are considered enhanced.

trait.name: One with the Force
entries: The Father cannot be moved against his will. He has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against being {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded}, {@condition Deafened|sw5e-phb|deafened}, {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned}, or knocked {@condition Unconscious|sw5e-phb|unconscious}.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If The Father fails a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Father casts *push/pull* twice, or he casts *push/pull* once and makes a Force Grip or Force Slam attack.

action.name: Force Grip
entries: If the father has successfully affected a creature with {@spell Force Push/Pull|sw5e-phb|Force push/pull} or {@spell Telekinesis|sw5e-phb}, he can use one of his attacks to target the affected creature again. The target must make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC 23). On a failure, the target becomes {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb|restrained} and {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} by the Father who can only have one target {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} this way. A {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} creature may use their action to attempt to escape the force grip by succeeding at a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC 23).

action.name: Force Slam
entries: The Father slams a creature {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} by Force Grip. A {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} creature must make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC 23). On a failure, the creature takes 105 (30d6) kinetic damage. On a success, the creature escapes the grapple.

action.name: Will
entries: The Father targets one creature he can see within 120ft. That target must succeed on a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC 23), unless the target is {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated}, it can avert it's attention to automatically succeed the save. If the target does so, they can't see The father until the start of his next turn, if the target again focuses on the father in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

action.name: 1. Beguiling Will
entries: The target is {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} until the start of The Father's next turn.

action.name: 2. Commanding Will
entries: The target is {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} until the start of their next turn. As part of this action, The Father shouts a verbal command, and if the target fails his save he uses his actions, movement, and reactions as determined by the command. At the start of its next and subsequent turns, the creature may make repeat the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: 3. Suppress Will (Recharge 6)
entries: The target immediately loses {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} on any {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} they had active, and suppresses any {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} effects they were benefiting from. At the start of its next and subsequent turns, the creature may make repeat the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, ending the effect on a success. While this effect remains active, the target cannot cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} or benefit from any force effects including racial and class features that rely on the force (such as {@spell Force Sight|sw5e-phb|force sight}, guardian auras, and sentinel ideals). (*While concentrating on ths effect, the father cannot use his Controling Will Legendary action until the start of his next turn.*)

legendary.name: Quick Casting
entries: The father can cast one of his At Will {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

legendary.name: Controling Will
entries: The father uses his Will action, choosing from either his Beguiling Will or Commanding Will options.

legendary.name: Force Step
entries: The father teleports up to 60 feet into an unoccupied space he can see.

legendaryHeader: The The Father, Avatar of Balance can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The The Father, Avatar of Balance regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

monster.name: The Son, Avatar of Power
resist: ion, and energy damage from unenhanced weaponry

trait.name: Beast Form
entries: The Son can transition between humanoid and beast forms using a legendary action. While in beast form, the Son uses his Charisma modifier for attack and damage rolls when making a claw attack, and adds his Wisdom modifier to his AC.

trait.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While in his humanoid form, the Son adds his Charisma modifier to his AC.

trait.name: Innate Forcecasting
entries: The Son's {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} Ability is Charisma, (power save DC 21, +13 to hit with force attacks). It can innately cast the following {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}:

trait.name: Dark Resistance
entries: The Son has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} against the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against Dark {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}

trait.name: Font of Power
entries: When the Son rolls damage on a power or {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, he can use his {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to reroll a number of the damage dice equal to his charisma modifier (7). He must use the new rolls.

trait.name: Enhanced Casting
entries: The Son's {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} are considered Enhanced.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If The Son fails a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Dark Lightning
entries: When the son successfully deals lightning damage to a creature, he can activate one of the following effects as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} (on his turn) or by using a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} (on another creature's turn).

trait.name: 1. Powerful Burst:
entries: On a success, the target is pushed 10ft, and on a failure, the target is knocked {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone} as well.

trait.name: 2. Lingering Burst:

trait.name: 4. Weakening Burst:

trait.name: 5. Debilitating Burst:

monster.name: Leviathan

trait.name: Gargantuan Strength
entries: The leviathan's melee weapon attacks are considered enhanced.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the leviathan fails a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Nightmare of the Force
entries: The leviathan's thoughts and location can't be discerned by the Force. Any creature who would use the Force to sense the leviathan in any way must make a DC 18 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or take 14 (4d6) psychic damage and be {@condition Deafened|sw5e-phb|deafened} by the sound of phantom screams in their mind for the next minute. While {@condition Deafened|sw5e-phb|deafened}, the Force-user takes an additional 14 (4d6) psychic damage at the start of each of their turns, and they may remake the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} as an action in order to end the effect.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The leviathan deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Sith-born
entries: Dark forcecasters and Sith (species) have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@skill Animal Handling|sw5e-phb} checks against leviathans.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The leviathan can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Claw
entries: *{@atk mw} * {@hit 18} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 ({@dice 2d6+10}) kinetic damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: *{@atk mw} * {@hit 18} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 23 ({@dice 3d8+10}) kinetic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} by the leviathan, that creature is swallowed, and the grapple ends. A swallowed creature is {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded} and {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb|restrained}, it has {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|total cover} against attacks and other effects outside the leviathan, and it takes 21 ({@dice 6d6}) acid damage at the start of each of the leviathan's turns. If the leviathan takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the leviathan must succeed on a {@dc 26} Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone} in a space within 10 feet of the leviathan. If the leviathan dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb|restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: *{@atk mw} * {@hit 18} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 20 ({@dice 3d6+10}) kinetic damage, and the target is {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} (escape {@dc 18}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb|restrained}. The leviathan has two tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the leviathan's choice that is within 120 feet of the leviathan and aware of it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or become {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the leviathan's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The leviathan exhales fire in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 24 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking 91 (26d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Tentacle
entries: The leviathan makes a tentacle attack.

legendary.name: Life Drain (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} by the leviathan takes 21 (6d6) necrotic damage, and the leviathan regains {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the total damage dealt to all targets. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, the leviathan kills the target by extracting and absorbing its life force, gaining all its knowledge and memories. Killing the leviathan frees all its captive life forces. This attack does not affect droids.

If a target would take 0 lightning damage from this attack, they do not take any necrotic damage from it either.

action.name: Tidal Wave (Recharge 6)
entries: While submerged, the leviathan creates a wall of water centered on itself. The wall is up to 250 feet long, up to 250 feet high, and up to 50 feet thick. When the wall appears, all other creatures within its area must each make a DC 23 Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes 33 (6d10) kinetic damage on failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. At the start of each of the leviathan's turns after the wall appears, the wall, along with any other creatures in it, moves 50 feet away from the leviathan. Any Huge or smaller creature inside the wall or whose space the wall enters when it moves must succeed on a DC 23 Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or take 27 (5d10) kinetic damage. A creature takes this damage no more than once on a turn. At the end of each turn the wall moves, the wall's height is reduced by 50 feet, and the damage creatures take from the wall on subsequent rounds is reduced by 1d10. When the wall reaches 0 feet in height, the effect ends. A creature caught in the wall can move by swimming. Because of the force of the wave, though, the creature must make a successful DC 23 Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) check to swim at all during that turn.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: Mnggal-Mnggal can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Mnggal-Mnggal can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Consumption
entries: Mnggal-Mnggal can consume creatures whole, engulfing them in its protoplasm. An engulfed creature is {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded}, {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb|restrained}, can’t breathe, has {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|total cover} against attacks and other effects outside Mnggal-Mnggal, and takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of Mnggal-Mnggal's turns. An engulfed creature can try to escape by using its action to make a DC 17 Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of Mnggal-Mnggal. A creature within 5 feet of Mnggal-Mnggal can also attempt to pull an engulfed target free in the nearest unoccupied space as an action. Doing so requires a successful DC 17 Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) check, and the creature making the attempt takes 7 (2d6) acid damage. Mnggal-Mnggal can hold up to four Medium or smaller creatures inside it at a time. If a creature is reduced to 0 hitpoints, Mnggal-Mnggal can choose to either digest the creature, which kills it outright, or use its Infect Host action on the creature.

trait.name: Force Resistance
entries: Mnggal-Mnggal has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

A {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} target takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of its turn.

action.name: Acid Spit
entries: Mnggal-Mnggal expunges needle-like projectiles of ooze within a 30 ft. cone in any direction from its space. All creatures in the area must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or take 11 (2d10) acid damage on a failed save. A target that failed the save must make a DC 16 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. {@condition Unconscious|sw5e-phb} creatures make this save with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}. On a failed save creature becomes {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb}. Creatures {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned} in this way take 11 (2d10) {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage at the start of their turn. This damage ignores {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} and immunity. A creature reduced to 0 hitpoints by this damage is killed instantly, and rises the next round as a Mnggal-Mnggal zombie. Creatures can repeat the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} at the end of their turn, ending the effect on a successful save.

action.name: Engulf
entries: Mnggal-Mnggal moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. While doing so, it can enter huge or smaller creatures’ spaces. Whenever Mnggal-Mnggal enters a creature’s space, the creature must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a successful {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of Mnggal-Mnggal. If it doesn’t choose to be moved, it suffers the consequences of a failed {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, the creature takes 21 (2d6+5) bludgeoning damage and 7 (2d6) acid damage and is consumed by Mnggal-Mnggal.

action.name: Infect Host

A creature that is {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} or consumed must make a DC 16 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to keep the ooze out of their mouth, on a failed save the creature becomes {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb}. {@condition Unconscious|sw5e-phb} creatures make this save with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}. This damage ignores {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} and immunity. A creature reduced to 0 hitpoints by this damage is killed instantly, and rises the next round as a Mnggal-Mnggal zombie. Creatures can repeat this {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} at the end of their turn. A creature that has successfully saved is immune to this ability for 24 hours.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: Mnggal-Mnggal can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Mnggal-Mnggal can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Consumption
entries: Mnggal-Mnggal can consume creatures whole, engulfing them in its protoplasm. An engulfed creature is {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded}, {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb|restrained}, can’t breathe, has {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|total cover} against attacks and other effects outside Mnggal-Mnggal, and takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of Mnggal-Mnggal's turns. An engulfed creature can try to escape by using its action to make a DC 24 Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of Mnggal-Mnggal. A creature within 5 feet of Mnggal-Mnggal can also attempt to pull an engulfed target free in the nearest unoccupied space as an action. Doing so requires a successful DC 24 Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) check, and the creature making the attempt takes 7 (2d6) acid damage. Mnggal-Mnggal can hold up to 1 huge creature, two Large creatures, or up to eight Medium or smaller creatures inside it at a time. If a creature is reduced to 0 hitpoints, Mnggal-Mnggal can choose to either digest the creature, which kills it outright, or use its Infect Host action on the creature.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/day)

trait.name: Regeneration

trait.name: Spider-climb

A {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} target takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of its turn.

action.name: Acid Spit
entries: Mnggal-Mnggal expunges needle-like projectiles of ooze within a 30ft. cone in any direction from its space. All creatures in the area must make a DC 20 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or take 22 (4d10) acid damage on a failed save. A target that failed the save must make a DC 23 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. {@condition Unconscious|sw5e-phb} creatures make this save with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}. On a failed save creature becomes {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb}. Creatures {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned} in this way take 27 (5d10) {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage at the start of their turn. This damage ignores {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} and immunity. A creature reduced to 0 hitpoints by this damage is killed instantly, and rises the next round as a Mnggal-Mnggal zombie. Creatures can repeat the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} at the end of their turn, ending the effect on a successful save.

action.name: Engulf
entries: Mnggal-Mnggal moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. While doing so, it can enter huge or smaller creatures’ spaces. Whenever Mnggal-Mnggal enters a creature’s space, the creature must make a DC 24 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a successful {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of Mnggal-Mnggal. If it doesn’t choose to be moved, it suffers the consequences of a failed {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, the creature takes 21 (3d8+8) bludgeoning damage and 7 (2d6) acid damage and is consumed by Mnggal-Mnggal.
